title: Elegoo H1 HT review: This filament drybox finally fixes the biggest issue with the Centauri Carbon 2 3D printer — and feels like a sign that Elegoo's getting serious with its upgrades now
summary: It fixes the Centauri Carbon 2's open-spool weakness, though one unit covers just one spool, so you’ll need four. With the filament inside, it exits the dryer through one of two outlets.
